cohort: This study included Somali women (aged 18 years or older) who had singleton births in Olmsted County, Minnesota, between January 2009 and December 2014, compared to an age-matched non-Somali cohort.
finding: Somali women in Olmsted County, Minnesota, had significantly higher odds of cesarean section but lower odds of postpartum depression compared to non-Somali women.
mod_finding: Somali women had a significantly higher odds of cesarean section compared to non-Somali women.
